author: Gmelin, 1789
summary: 논이나 습지에 사는 여름철새로, 국내에서는 강원도, 경기도, 충청남도 일부 지역에서 산다. 아침과 저녁에는 벼가 자라는 논과 논둑에서 활발히 움직이지만, 낮에는 근처 물가나 구릉의 풀숲, 논 주변 덤불에 숨어 지낸다. 곤충, 물고기, 양서류와 풀, 식물 씨앗을 먹고, 논의 벼 포기를 모으거나 풀숲의 풀줄기와 잎으로 엉성한 접시 모양 둥지를 지어 한배에 알 3~5개를 낳는다. 국외에서는 일본, 타이완, 필리핀, 인도, 인도네시아, 말레이반도, 스리랑카 등지에 분포한다.

points.en: buff-brown body with dark brown spots (female)

sexes.male: 여름깃은 푸른빛이 도는 검은색이고 날개와 꼬리는 검은 갈색이며, 번식기에는 이마에서 머리꼭대기 위까지 붉은 이마판이 있다. 부리는 노랗다. 겨울깃은 암컷과 비슷하지만 부리가 더 굵고 노랗다.
sexes.female: 몸이 황갈색이고 등과 날개에 진한 갈색 반점이 있다.

art.subject: Watercock (Gallicrex cinerea), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen in Korean rice paddies from June to August: head, neck and underparts sooty slate-black with a bluish tinge; upperparts and wings blackish-brown with paler grey-brown feather edges giving a faintly scaly look; undertail coverts barred buff; a bright red frontal shield extending up the forehead into a raised horn-like knob above the crown; bill red at the base and yellow towards the tip; reddish-brown eye; legs red.
art.pose: walking along a rice-paddy levee in early morning light
art.scene: Korean summer rice paddies with growing rice, grassy levees and a bushy hillside nearby; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding, side view walking on a paddy levee: sooty bluish-black body, blackish-brown wings with pale edges, red frontal shield rising into a horn above the crown, red-based yellow bill, reddish-brown eye, red legs

adult female, side view: buff-brown body, crown and upperparts with dark brown feather centres giving a spotted, scaly pattern, paler buff underparts with fine wavy brown bars, yellowish bill, reddish-brown eye, pale green legs
adult male non-breeding, head detail: female-like buff-brown head with dark-centred crown feathers, no red shield, a thicker, larger yellow bill than the female's
art.build: Large, upright, chicken-like rail; males about 40cm, clearly bigger than Common Moorhen, females smaller (33cm). Small head on a fairly long neck, plump body. Bill stout, a little shorter than the head, deep at the base and pointed, joined to the frontal shield. Legs long and strong with long toes. Short tail, often flicked. Walks with deliberate steps and a nodding head; flies low with legs dangling.
avoid: Do not paint a white flank line or white undertail sides — that is Common Moorhen (Gallinula chloropus).
Do not paint a flat frontal shield on the breeding male; it rises into a horn-like knob above the crown.
Do not show the red shield on the female or the non-breeding male.
Do not paint a slender, long rail bill; the bill is short and stout.
